name: Himitsu no Houkago ~Abunai Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: ひ・み・つの放課後 ～危ない同棲性活～
source:
Main character works as a teacher. Director's daughter crashes to his new mortage flat and suggest cohabitation. Protagonist can not go against director's will with all the debts acquired, so two young people start to live together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名教师。主任的女儿闯入他的新抵押公寓并建议同居。主角无法违背导演的意愿，债台高筑，两个年轻人开始同居。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
